retainedReference.title: Kiosk for Breaking Fast, Topkapi Palace

pictures.author: Moonik
pictures.observed: Open dark slender posts supporting a broad gilded roof/eaves, low white stone platform, short white baluster side guards, four small corner roof finials and central tall ornamental spindle/open crest. City-view terrace; independent long balustrade and Baghdad kiosk excluded.

pictures.author: Jose Luiz Bernardes Ribeiro
pictures.observed: Curved squared gilded bell/cushion roof with shallow rising center, gilded corner bulbs and long main spindle. Fine open/beaded scalloped eave fringe and dark soffit; thin dark metal posts. Calligraphic crest is observed but not copied; simplified open geometric crest only.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Iftar/Kiosk for Breaking Fast: open six-post dark-metal canopy over a low pale stone platform with three short baluster guards/open garden entry, broad gilded eaves, curved rectangular bell/cushion roof, four small corner finials and tall central spindle with a simplified open crest. Gold beaded/scalloped eave border and dark plain soffit; no copied calligraphic crest/art or independent Baghdad/pool/precinct balustrade.
